title: Customer Change Orders on Window Contracts
content:
# Customer Change Orders on Window Contracts

**Window Replacement Contracts — estimating terms for change orders**

1. A customer change order adds options or openings to the contract.
2. A change order can be written only while the contract status is signed or measured. Once the order is released, the custom product is in production and no change order is accepted.
3. Each line is priced at the series price per opening for the option times the openings affected; an added opening is priced at the series base price per opening, and options for an added opening are separate lines.
4. Exterior color can be ordered only in a series where it is available.
5. All lines written on the same date form one change order.
6. A contract may carry no more customer change orders than the series maximum; a request beyond it is refused.
7. The customer change orders of a contract are counted; those up to the series free count carry no fee, and each later change order carries the series change-order fee once, on the date it is written. *The words "each later change order carries the series change-order fee once, on the date it is written" are no longer in force for a customer change order beyond the series free count: the fee for such a change order is figured under the current change-order fee terms, still charged once and dated the day the change order was written.* Change orders within the free count stay free.
8. Adding openings may not take the contract above the series maximum opening count.

The priced options are premium Low-E, triple-pane glass, grilles between the glass, exterior color, tempered glass, laminated glass, obscure glass and hardware finish, each at its series price per opening, and an added opening at the series base price per opening.

## How change orders are counted

Change orders are counted by the dates on which customer change-order lines were written: every line written on one date belongs to one change order. An oversize surcharge line written at the final measure is not a customer change order.

## Hypothetical line pricing

A hypothetical change order adds triple-pane glass to 4 openings and 1 added opening, in a series where (hypothetically) triple-pane is $100 per opening and the base price is $1,000 per opening. It writes two lines on one date: triple-pane, $400.00 (4 times $100); added opening, $1,000.00. Both lines form one change order.

## Status gate

| Contract status on record | Change order |
|---|---|
| Signed or measured | May be written |
| Ordered, installed, closed or cancelled | Not written |
